title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court concerning How Capital Verification Units Shall Bear Liability for Losses of Creditors in Multiple Cases

articles.content_en:
Sichuan Higher People's Court:

Your Court's Request for Instructions on How Capital Verification Units Shall Bear Liability for Losses of Creditors in Multiple Cases (Chuan Gao Fa [1997] No. 77) has been received. Upon study, the reply is as follows:

Where a financial institution or accounting firm issues an untrue capital verification report or false capital certification for a company, and the company becomes insolvent, such capital verification unit shall bear civil compensation liability for the company's debts within the untrue portion of the capital verification report or the amount of the false capital certification.

Where the cumulative liability borne by the capital verification unit to one or more creditors within the untrue portion of the capital verification has reached the limit of the portion for which it shall bear liability, it shall no longer bear compensation liability to other creditors of the company.

Where multiple creditors claim payment at the same time, the capital verification unit shall, within the amount of the false registered capital or certification it issued for the verified unit, bear compensation liability proportionally for the portion for which it shall bear liability.

This is our reply.
